name: pushrim
title: Pushrim
description: A disability-sport charity theme on a honey beech sports-hall floor, whose home page sets the impact figure as a tabletop flip scoreboard — one black card per digit in a blue A-frame stand — with court-tape rules and a black-card Donate button.

tokens.--font-display: rounded sans: headings, site title, menu, buttons, bold words, the foot strip and the scoreboard caption
tokens.--font-figures: fixed-pitch face: scoreboard figures (one card per character), table figures, dates, code
tokens.--text-s: small text — dates, table headings, the footer
tokens.--text-m: body text and the foot strip
tokens.--text-l: ledes, the mission text, buttons, table figures and the scoreboard caption
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the mission headline
tokens.--text-score: largest size of the scoreboard figures; on narrow screens they shrink so seven cards fit
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings, buttons and captions
tokens.--color-text: black ink — body text, headings and links
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: list descriptions, dates, table headings, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the scoreboard's blue A-frame stand and the strips of stand between its cards; nowhere else
tokens.--color-accent-ink: the words on the stand's foot strip
tokens.--color-accent-deep: the stand's top rail, legs and the line above its foot strip
tokens.--color-card: the black flip cards, the black-card Donate buttons and the skip link
tokens.--color-card-ink: figures and words on the black cards
tokens.--color-card-edge: edges of the cards stacked under each flip card and Donate button
tokens.--color-ring: the metal ring pairs on the scoreboard cards and the black-card Donate buttons
tokens.--color-tape-white: white court tape: masthead, footer, the court line under the scoreboard, the baseline beside the home page body, table lines, rules, pagination, the get-involved box
tokens.--color-tape-yellow: yellow court tape above each entry in a list, under section headings in the text, and the key marked beside the home page body
tokens.--color-tape-red: red court tape: the current menu entry, the line beside a quotation, link hover
tokens.--color-grain: the tone that varies from one floor board to the next
tokens.--color-wash: pale wash behind code and behind a hero photograph while it loads
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of black cards, the get-involved box, code and photographs
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of menu links and other tap targets
